prompt.text:
Arrange the paragraphs in the correct order. Three paragraphs have already been placed.

A. A final observation brings the discussion to a close.

B. A useful example explains the earlier point.

C. The next paragraph introduces a contrast.

D. A concluding paragraph summarizes the argument.

E. An opening explanation defines the central idea.

F. The introduction presents the topic.

G. A further example develops the contrast.

H. The discussion then turns to a new aspect.
